IRON YARD — one owner-authorized PUBLIC FPS performance update, 12 November 2026.

The owner requested continued work on the EXISTING public IRON YARD Roblox
experience. Keep the same owner-verified universe and root place. Do not
create a new experience, do not publish a private alpha, and do not change
the public visibility or ownership of any destination.

This one-shot release includes merged PR #30, squash commit
bfb3f1559ced4b662a3a1d5b7323a504bf765a0d:
stop the 8 Hz traversal of already expired client-side bullet-mark pool
entries during idle mobile gameplay. Wake the existing render-loop scan
on the next accepted local impact; keep marks alive independently of LOD
visibility so graphics preset upgrades can reveal still-live marks.

The full standalone Luau regression suites, source integration checks,
compiler, and Rojo build all succeeded on the PR and merged main.
Re-run the complete CI for this exact release authorization commit,
and only dispatch one public release if the exact commit's CI is green.

No server damage, ammunition, remote events, raycasts, asset ownership,
hitboxes, graphics budgets, or input logic are altered.
No extra RenderStepped callbacks, instances, tweens or background jobs.
No API keys, credentials or private Roblox identifiers are included.

The target-checking PUBLIC Roblox workflow must independently validate
creator, universe visibility, root place, the intended exact destination,
the source commit and CI before issuing a new Roblox place version.
Do not claim measured Android FPS, studio playtest or actual publication
until independent matching evidence exists.
